J4 · Interest Evolution

Interest evolution is only shown when topic-level data exists.

full screenneeds A/B/CP3tab: journey

What this file is

Rendered by packages/ui/mockups/render.mjs from the real components in packages/ui/screens through the DOM binding, with the generated token CSS inlined. It is not a drawing of the screen.

What to check

An "empty" frame is rendered for a persona that lacks a tier this screen needs, so it shows the real degraded state: what Mirror says when it cannot measure something.

Reproduce

npm run tokens && npm run mockups
